text: {"distance_m": 7, "reasoning_short": "This is an estimate, not an exact value. 20/20 vision resolves about 1 arcmin, and a 2 mm spot subtends 1 arcmin at about 6.9 m (0.002 / tan(1′)). A tiny spot is detected from contrast times area, not resolved, so a full-contrast dark dot can be seen at about 0.5 arcmin. At 30% contrast the threshold grows by 1/√0.3, to about 0.9 arcmin. That gives roughly 7–7.5 m, so about 7 m."}
